why_ai: Unlicensed software marketplace; tracking, payouts and partner admin are all code AI-native platforms can rebuild.
why_clarity: Every sale is tracked and paid by rule, but whether commissions bought incremental sales is unverified.
why_digital: Clicks, cookies, commissions and partner deals all live and are sold online.

why_ai: Cheap holdout experiments are software, though finance buyers want a credible independent measurer.
why_clarity: Holdout lift is a defined number from a codified experiment design, read after weeks.
why_digital: Experiment runs on transaction data and returns a digital report to remote buyers.

why_ai: Attribution is a network rule in code; the hard part is contested credit, not human presence.
why_clarity: Every transaction recurs, but fair contribution has no agreed ground truth to check against.
why_digital: Touch sequences and outcomes are clickstream data processed and paid out online.

why_ai: Validation, clawback and rate changes are rules and reconciliation that software absorbs directly.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical transaction approvals against written programme terms, checked against order data.
why_digital: Approvals, returns and rate threads are all screen and email work on transaction records.

why_ai: Mechanical reconciliation and payouts; money handling and tax forms keep some regulated provider demand.
why_clarity: Five sets of terms and statements reconcile to exact, checkable payment amounts every cycle.
why_digital: Statements, reconciliation and bank transfers are fully remote fintech workflows.

why_ai: A well-posed recommender on the network's own cross-merchant performance data replaces directory browsing.
why_clarity: Publisher sales per merchant are observed outcomes, but partnerships take months to prove out.
why_digital: Publisher performance records in, ranked partner lists out, all inside network software.

why_ai: Mechanical data join between network conversions and creator content that software performs outright.
why_clarity: Clear deliverable: map each commission to its content, checkable against click and conversion logs.
why_digital: Click, conversion and traffic data joined in software, delivered as dashboards to creators.

why_ai: Admin queue is automatable; partner relationships and brand-fit choices still need a person.
why_clarity: Half the month is repetitive queues, half is partnership development done by feel.
why_digital: Consoles, inboxes and remote partner calls, with occasional conference relationship building.

why_ai: Adversarial fraud tactics keep humans adjudicating, but detection itself moves into learning software.
why_clarity: Tactics evolve faster than the rulebook, and missed fraud surfaces late or never.
why_digital: Cookie stuffing and trademark bidding are detected entirely from network traffic data.

why_ai: Earnings analytics and payment consolidation for creators are both pure software products.
why_clarity: Earnings joins and five-network reconciliation are mechanical, recurring and objectively checkable.
why_digital: Dashboards, statements and payments delivered online to remote creators.

why_ai: The whole programme, recruiting to payouts, can be operated automatically by software.
why_clarity: Standard programme steps repeat across many small merchants; sales results arrive over months.
why_digital: Recruiting, validation and payouts are run online for merchants who never meet anyone.
